{{Top|leg}}
'''Assault corvettes''' were a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One Imperial assault corvette destroyed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] ship ''[[Pride of Stars]]''.<ref name="OAA1">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>
